verdict.rationale: The skills themselves are independently versioned. `yy skills install`/`update` selects the latest compatible stable release. Differing customized or unrecorded copies are flagged for review rather than silently overwritten, which gives versioning and some review of the skill-based automations. Missing for 10: a documented rollback or pin-to-previous-version capability, a review workflow for user-authored automations (beyond flagging customized copies), version history or diff tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Seven independently versioned Skills help agents use Ledger Records, understand projects, plan work, and deliver one bounded task.
Run `yy skills install` or `yy skills update` explicitly to select the latest compatible stable release and update all three agent copies.
differing customized/unrecorded copies require review. Unrecorded legacy copies remain preserved and flagged, not silently deleted.
It checks nested references for retired lifecycle instructions as well as invocation contracts and plugin version parity.
